name: stability ball rollout on knees
description: A kneeling rollout with the forearms on a stability ball. It builds deep core strength.
instructions: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.
